settings.name: USE_AUTH_BASIC
settings.description: **Enable Auth Basic:** Set to `yes` to enable basic authentication.

settings.name: AUTH_BASIC_LOCATION
settings.description: **Protection Scope:** Set to `sitewide` to protect the entire site, or specify a URL path (e.g., `/admin`) to protect only specific areas. You can also use Nginx-style modifiers (`=`, `~`, `~*`, `^~`).

settings.name: AUTH_BASIC_USER
settings.description: **Username:** The username required for authentication. You can define multiple username/password pairs.

settings.name: AUTH_BASIC_PASSWORD
settings.description: **Password:** The password required for authentication. Passwords are hashed using scrypt for maximum security.

settings.name: AUTH_BASIC_TEXT
settings.description: **Prompt Text:** The message displayed in the authentication prompt shown to users.
